library_hours.label: Library opening hours
library_hours.answer: The Central Library is open 08:00 to 22:00 Monday to Friday and 09:00 to 18:00 on Saturday and Sunday. During the final-exam fortnight the reading hall stays open until 24:00. It is closed on public holidays.

sources.title: VoxSure demo knowledge base (author-written sample entry)

library_borrow.label: Borrowing, renewing or fines for library books
library_borrow.answer: Students can borrow up to 4 books for 14 days using their student ID card. Books can be renewed twice online through the library account, unless another member has reserved them. Late returns cost 5 per day, and lost books must be reported to the circulation desk.
library_borrow.short: borrowing, renewing or fines for library books

sources.title: VoxSure demo knowledge base (author-written sample entry)

academic_calendar.label: Academic calendar and key dates
academic_calendar.answer: The academic calendar is published on the student portal under Academics. It lists semester start and end dates, holidays, vacations, add/drop deadlines and the convocation date. Check it there for the latest approved dates.
academic_calendar.short: the academic calendar and key dates

sources.title: VoxSure demo knowledge base (author-written sample entry)

exam_info.label: Exams, hall tickets and results
exam_info.answer: The exam timetable and hall tickets are released on the student portal about two weeks before exams. Carry your hall ticket and student ID. Results are published on the portal, and revaluation requests are accepted for a few days after results through the Examination Office.

sources.title: VoxSure demo knowledge base (author-written sample entry)

fee_payment.label: Paying fees or getting fee receipts
fee_payment.answer: Fees can be paid online through the student portal (card, net banking or UPI) or at the accounts counter during working hours. A receipt is generated automatically after payment. If money was deducted but the payment failed, contact the accounts office with the transaction reference.

sources.title: VoxSure demo knowledge base (author-written sample entry)

hostel_info.label: Hostel rooms, rules and fees
hostel_info.answer: Hostel applications open after admission confirmation, and rooms are allotted by the hostel office. Curfew is 22:00, and visitors are allowed in the visitors' lounge only. Report maintenance problems to the hostel warden's office or through the helpdesk.

sources.title: VoxSure demo knowledge base (author-written sample entry)

it_helpdesk.label: Wi-Fi, passwords or portal login problems
it_helpdesk.answer: For password resets use the 'Forgot password' link on the portal login page. For Wi-Fi or portal access problems, raise a ticket with the IT helpdesk, which is located in the main administrative block. Mention your student ID and a short description of the problem.
it_helpdesk.short: Wi-Fi, passwords or portal login problems

sources.title: VoxSure demo knowledge base (author-written sample entry)

placement_process.label: Placements and internships
placement_process.answer: Students register on the placement portal and upload a resume. Eligible students are shortlisted for company drives, which include tests, interviews and pre-placement talks. The Training and Placement Office also runs mock interviews. Eligibility criteria are announced per company.

sources.title: VoxSure demo knowledge base (author-written sample entry)

scholarship_aid.label: Scholarships and financial aid
scholarship_aid.answer: Merit and need-based scholarships are available. Applications are submitted through the student portal with income proof and mark sheets before the notified deadline. You can track your application status on the same page. Contact the Financial Aid Office for eligibility questions.

sources.title: VoxSure demo knowledge base (author-written sample entry)

certificates.label: Transcripts, bonafide and other certificates
certificates.answer: Bonafide, character and transfer certificates, and transcripts, are requested through the student portal's Certificates section. Processing normally takes three to seven working days. Duplicate documents need a written request and a fee at the Registrar's Office.

sources.title: VoxSure demo knowledge base (author-written sample entry)

campus_services.label: Canteen, medical centre, transport or clubs
campus_services.answer: The canteen and food court are open from 08:00 to 20:00. The medical centre is next to the sports complex and is open on weekdays. A shuttle connects the hostels with the academic block, and clubs open their registrations at the start of each semester.
campus_services.short: campus services such as the canteen, medical centre or transport

greeting.label: Greeting
greeting.answer: Hello! I'm VoxSure, a student support assistant. Ask me about the library, exams, fees, hostels, placements, scholarships, certificates or IT help.

thanks_bye.label: Thanks or goodbye
thanks_bye.answer: You're welcome! Come back any time you need help.

about_bot.label: About the assistant
about_bot.answer: I'm VoxSure, a voice-enabled student support assistant. I listen to your question, show you what I heard so you can correct it, work out what you need, and answer from a reviewed knowledge base. When I'm not sure, I ask you instead of guessing. I'm an AI, not a person.

help_capabilities.label: What I can help with
help_capabilities.answer: I can help with: library hours and borrowing, the academic calendar, exams and results, fee payment, hostels, IT helpdesk problems, placements, scholarships, certificates, and campus services like the canteen and medical centre. Just ask in your own words, by voice or typing. If you ask something outside these topics, I'll tell you plainly so you can rephrase it or contact the right office.

fallback_out_of_scope: That's outside what I can help with, so I won't guess. I can answer questions about the library, calendar, exams, fees, hostels, IT help, placements, scholarships, certificates and campus services. Try rephrasing, or ask me "What can you do?"
fallback_repeated: I'm still not sure I understood. You can type your question instead, rephrase it, or press Reset to start again.
repair_prompt: I'm not confident I heard that correctly. Please check the transcript and edit it, or say it again.
clarify_prompt: I want to be sure I give you the right answer. Which of these do you mean?
clarify_prompt_template: Just to be sure, do you mean {options}?
repair_prompt_typed: I'm not sure I understood that. Could you rephrase it? I can help with the library, exams, fees, hostels, placements, scholarships, certificates and IT help.
